description: Needs an Alion account or an x402 payment (not free on this open address). What changed at companies, newest first: funding rounds, new countries and offices, technologies taken up or dropped, hiring spikes, a size band up, ATS adopted, leadership hires, first roles, hiring freezes and layoffs, launches, partnerships and customers won, awards, acquisitions, renames, accelerator batches, and Buying windows opened (a dated reason to buy). Across the graph narrowed by country, industry and size, or over up to 100 companies you name; since reaches back 90 days (default 7). Each row: the company card, the type, the day and what happened with its source. Poll it with next_cursor or follow it with watch_search kind=events. count_only is free. $0.005 an event. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

company.description: Only these companies: a domain, id or name, or a comma list of up to 100.

country.description: Headquarters country: ISO code or a comma list.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; keep the other arguments identical.

industry.description: Industry by name, e.g. "Fintech", or a comma list.

since.description: An ISO date or a window ("24h", "7d", "2w"); at most 90 days back, default 7 days.

type.description: One type or a comma list: funding_round, geo_expansion, office_opened, technology_added, technology_dropped, hiring_spike, size_up, ats_adopted, leadership_hire, first_role, hiring_freeze, layoff, product_launch, partnership, customer_won, award, acquisition, acquired, shutdown, renamed, accelerator, role_open_45d, role_open_90d, buying_window_opened. Default: all but the role_open_* ones.

name: search_company_events

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day of the fact

detail.description: What happened: a round and its amount, the technology, the country, the headline and its source...

meta.description: Quota and credit standing after this call.

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.

free_reads_left_today.description: Compact reads still free today for an assistant connected through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT)

mark.description: People tools: the code of this account and UTC day; every list of people read today carries it

tier.description: anonymous, free, pro, partner or staff

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor, other arguments unchanged.

warnings.description: Arguments that were ignored or matched nothing, with what to try instead.

title: Company events feed
